english.title: Provide universal postal service without authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the authority of the universal service provider concerned, namely **(..SPECIFY PROVIDER..),

(A)_[placed]_
(B)_[maintained]_

(C)_[in]_
(D)_[on]_

(E)_[a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY SHIP..)]_
(F)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(G)_[an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..)]_
(H)_[premises, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..)]_

belonging to you or under your control, words letters or marks, namely **(..SPECIFY CHARACTERS..), which signified or implied, or may reasonably have led the public to believe, that the

(I)_[ship]_
(J)_[vehicle]_
(K)_[aircraft]_
(L)_[premises]_

was used by the universal service provider concerned for the purpose of collecting, receiving, sorting, delivering or conveying postal packets in connection with the provision of a universal postal service
english.legislation: Contrary to section 87(2)(a) and (5) of the Postal Services Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without the authority of the universal postal service provider
placed/maintained in/on a ship/vehicle/aircraft/premises
words/letters/marks leading the public to believe
that the ship/vehicle/aircraft/premises was used by a universal postal service
